theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightReportingOwnerSelect.program_meets {lim : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Limits} {μ : ℕ→ℤ} {f : ℕ→ℤ}
    {n g vals owners positions records i dst d : ℕ} {rs : List _root_.ThreeSum.BandCandidateRows.Record}
    (H : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.BandRawA.Stored μ vals owners positions f (_root_.ThreeSum.BandRawA.items n g rs))
    (HR : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Seg μ records (_root_.ThreeSum.BandCandidateRows.cells rs)) (hi : i<(_root_.ThreeSum.BandRawA.items n g rs).length)
    (hw : (lim.space : ℤ)≤lim.word)
    (hvals : vals+(_root_.ThreeSum.BandRawA.items n g rs).length≤lim.space)
    (howners : owners+(_root_.ThreeSum.BandRawA.items n g rs).length≤lim.space)
    (hrecords : records+4*rs.length≤lim.space)
    (hout : dst+4≤lim.space)
    (hvalue : |f (_root_.ThreeSum.BandRawA.labelAt n g rs i).position|≤lim.word)
    (hB : (_root_.ThreeSum.BandRawA.ownerRecord n g rs i).b≤lim.space) (hC : (_root_.ThreeSum.BandRawA.ownerRecord n g rs i).c≤lim.space) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Meets lim _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightReportingOwnerSelect.program 0 d [vals,owners,records,i,dst] μ 700
      (fun result ν => result=(dst : ℤ) ∧ _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Seg ν dst (_root_.ThreeSum.LightReportingOwnerSelect.row f n g rs i) ∧ _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.SameOutside μ ν dst 4) := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
Let $\lambda,\mu,d$ be limits, memory and depth, $f:\mathbb N\to\mathbb Z$ an original-value map, and $n,g$ array/band parameters. Suppose parallel value, owner and position arrays store the full A-incidence list generated by owner records $R$, and the four-cell records themselves are stored at their given base. Fix a valid incidence index $i$ and four-cell destination $b$. Assume addresses fit words; the value, owner and record arrays and destination fit memory; the selected original value fits a word; and its owner's B/C indices fit the address space. Then the fixed selector returns $b$ within $700$ steps, writes the exact selected owner row at $b$, and changes no cell outside those four.

This connects each physical wanted incidence to its own original value and owner-band identity.
